title: aaj sadiq ka jahan me janashee'n paida hua
body:
aaj sadiq ka jahan me janashee'n paida hua
musie kazim shahe dunya-o-dee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan hai shaad aur masroor hai huro malak
mustafa ka saatwa masnad nashee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate sadiq hai qush maadar hai bete par nisaar
qush hai baqir aaj pota mehjabee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shor hai salwat ka ghul hai mubarakbaad ka
hazrate sadiq ka farzande hasee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr se is shaahe dee'n ke ban gaya ummat ka kaam
saanie zainulleba sultane dee'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
qalq me har jaa'n bapa hai jashne meelaade imam
saatwa rehbar imamul muttaqi paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
haajate'n barla ilaahi momino ki jald tar
sadqa is moulood ka jo mehjabee'n paida hua
